030/**
031 * NotifyEvent $eventHandle <params> 
032 * 
033 */
034public class ZGRTurnIn extends BaseCommandPlugin {
035        
036        public static float VALUE_MULT = 3f;
037        public static float REP_MULT = 0.2f;
038        
039        protected CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet;
040        protected SectorEntityToken entity;
041        protected FactionAPI playerFaction;
042        protected FactionAPI entityFaction;
043        protected TextPanelAPI text;
044        protected OptionPanelAPI options;
045        protected CargoAPI playerCargo;
046        protected MemoryAPI memory;
047        protected InteractionDialogAPI dialog;
048        protected Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap;
049        protected PersonAPI person;
050        protected FactionAPI faction;
051
052        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
053                
054                this.dialog = dialog;
055                this.memoryMap = memoryMap;
056                
057                String command = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
058                if (command == null) return false;
059                
060                memory = getEntityMemory(memoryMap);
061                
062                entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
063                text = dialog.getTextPanel();
064                options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
065                
066                playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
067                playerCargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
068                
069                playerFaction = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
070                entityFaction = entity.getFaction();
071                
072                person = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getActivePerson();
073                faction = person.getFaction();
074                
075                if (command.equals("selectSellableItems")) {
076                        selectSellableItems();
077                } else if (command.equals("playerHasSellableItems")) {
078                        return playerHasSellableItems();
079                }
080                
081                return true;
082        }
083        
084
085        protected void selectSellableItems() {
086                CargoAPI copy = getSellableItems();
087                
088                float valueMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_ZGRTurnInValueMult") : 1f;
089                
090                final float width = 310f;
091                dialog.showCargoPickerDialog("Select items to turn in", "Confirm", "Cancel", true, width, copy, new CargoPickerListener() {
092                        public void pickedCargo(CargoAPI cargo) {
093                                if (cargo.isEmpty()) {
094                                        cancelledCargoSelection();
095                                        return;
096                                }
097                                
098                                cargo.sort();
099                                
100                                float bountyThreat = 0;
101                                float bountyMonster = 0;
102                                MemoryAPI mem = Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate();
103                                
104                                for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
105                                        playerCargo.removeItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), stack.getSize());
106                                        int num = (int) stack.getSize();
107                                        AddRemoveCommodity.addStackLossText(stack, text);
108                                        if (isThreatStack(stack)) {
109                                                bountyThreat += num * stack.getBaseValuePerUnit() * VALUE_MULT * valueMult;
110                                        } else if (isMonsterStack(stack)) {
111                                                bountyMonster += num * stack.getBaseValuePerUnit() * VALUE_MULT * valueMult;
112                                        }
113                                }
114                                
115                                float repChange = computeReputationValue(cargo);
116
117                                int bounty = (int) (bountyThreat + bountyMonster);
118                                if (bounty > 0) {
119                                        playerCargo.getCredits().add(bounty);
120                                        AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsGainText((int)bounty, text);
121                                        
122                                        String soldTotalKey = "$itemValueSoldToZGRThreat";
123                                        int curr = mem.getInt(soldTotalKey);
124                                        curr += bountyThreat;
125                                        mem.set(soldTotalKey, curr);
126                                        
127                                        soldTotalKey = "$itemValueSoldToZGRMonster";
128                                        curr = mem.getInt(soldTotalKey);
129                                        curr += bountyMonster;
130                                        mem.set(soldTotalKey, curr);
131                                        
132                                        soldTotalKey = "$itemValueSoldToZGRTotal";
133                                        curr = mem.getInt(soldTotalKey);
134                                        curr += bounty;
135                                        mem.set(soldTotalKey, curr);
136                                        
137                                }
138                                
139                                if (repChange >= 1f) {
140                                        CustomRepImpact impact = new CustomRepImpact();
141                                        impact.delta = repChange * 0.01f;
142                                        Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
143                                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOM, impact,
144                                                                                                  null, text, true), 
145                                                                                                  faction.getId());
146                                        
147                                        impact.delta *= 0.25f;
148                                        if (impact.delta >= 0.01f) {
149                                                Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
150                                                                new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOM, impact,
151                                                                                                          null, text, true), 
152                                                                                                          person);
153                                        }
154                                }
155                                
156                                mem.set("$itemValueSoldToZGRJustNowThreat", (int)bountyThreat, 0);
157                                mem.set("$itemValueSoldToZGRJustNowMonster", (int)bountyMonster, 0);
158                                mem.set("$itemValueSoldToZGRJustNowTotal", (int)bounty, 0);
159                                FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "ZGRItemsTurnedIn");
160                        }
161                        public void cancelledCargoSelection() {
162                        }
163                        public void recreateTextPanel(TooltipMakerAPI panel, CargoAPI cargo, CargoStackAPI pickedUp, boolean pickedUpFromSource, CargoAPI combined) {
164                        
165                                float bounty = 0f;
166                                for (CargoStackAPI stack : combined.getStacksCopy()) {
167                                        int num = (int) stack.getSize();
168                                        bounty += num * stack.getBaseValuePerUnit() * VALUE_MULT * valueMult;
169                                }
170                                
171                                float repChange = computeReputationValue(combined);
172                                
173                                float pad = 3f;
174                                float small = 5f;
175                                float opad = 10f;
176
177                                panel.setParaFontOrbitron();
178                                panel.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(faction.getDisplayName()), faction.getBaseUIColor(), 1f);
179                                //panel.addTitle(Misc.ucFirst(faction.getDisplayName()), faction.getBaseUIColor());
180                                //panel.addPara(faction.getDisplayNameLong(), faction.getBaseUIColor(), opad);
181                                //panel.addPara(faction.getDisplayName() + " (" + entity.getMarket().getName() + ")", faction.getBaseUIColor(), opad);
182                                panel.setParaFontDefault();
183                                
184                                panel.addImage(faction.getLogo(), width * 1f, 3f);
185                                
186                                panel.addPara("If you turn in the selected items, you will receive a %s bounty " +
187                                                "and your standing with " + faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + " will improve by %s points.",
188                                                opad * 1f, Misc.getHighlightColor(),
189                                                Misc.getWithDGS(bounty) + Strings.C,
190                                                "" + (int) repChange);
191                        }
192                });
193        }
194
195        protected float computeReputationValue(CargoAPI cargo) {
196                float rep = 0;
197                for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
198                        rep += getBaseRepValue(stack) * stack.getSize();
199                }
200                rep *= REP_MULT;
201                return rep;
202        }
203        
204        public static float getBaseRepValue(CargoStackAPI stack) {
205                if (stack.isWeaponStack()) {
206                        switch (stack.getWeaponSpecIfWeapon().getSize()) {
207                        case LARGE: return 3f;
208                        case MEDIUM: return 2f;
209                        case SMALL: return 1f;
210                        }
211                }
212                if (stack.isSpecialStack()) {
213                        return 5f;
214                }
215                return 1f;
216        }
217        
218        
219        protected boolean playerHasSellableItems() {
220                return !getSellableItems().isEmpty();
221        }
222        
223        public static boolean isThreatStack(CargoStackAPI stack) {
224                boolean match = false;
225                match |= stack.isWeaponStack() && stack.getWeaponSpecIfWeapon().hasTag(Tags.THREAT); 
226                match |= stack.isSpecialStack() && stack.getSpecialItemSpecIfSpecial().hasTag(Tags.THREAT);
227                return match;
228        }
229        public static boolean isMonsterStack(CargoStackAPI stack) {
230                boolean match = false;
231                match |= stack.isWeaponStack() && stack.getWeaponSpecIfWeapon().hasTag(Tags.MONSTER); 
232                match |= stack.isSpecialStack() && stack.getSpecialItemSpecIfSpecial().hasTag(Tags.MONSTER);
233                return match;
234        }
235        
236        protected CargoAPI getSellableItems() {
237                CargoAPI copy = Global.getFactory().createCargo(false);
238                for (CargoStackAPI stack : playerCargo.getStacksCopy()) {
239                        boolean match = isThreatStack(stack) || isMonsterStack(stack);
240                        if (match) {
241                                copy.addFromStack(stack);
242                        }
243                }
244                copy.sort();
245                return copy;
246        }
247        
248        
249}
